title: Weak-model plan output contract (plan mode)
description: JSON counterpart of the markdown plan template checked by scripts/check_ai_protocol.py --mode plan. Each property is the line content of the corresponding markdown section ('Section:' -> snake_case), as an array of strings. Aligned checks: all six sections required; 'Applicable harnesses' and 'Verification plan' must be non-empty (minItems 1); total lines (sum of array lengths + scalar strings) must not exceed the plan budget of 6 (LINE_BUDGETS.plan) - the sum is enforced by check_ai_protocol.py --schema code, not by JSON Schema. Forbidden noise phrases (chain of thought, hidden reasoning, ...) are rejected on all string content.

objective.description: Objective: what the bounded task achieves.

applicable_harnesses.description: Applicable harnesses: harness paths or ids selected for the task (never empty; use the router output as the starting point).

applicable_checklist_items.description: Applicable checklist items: the specific items that will be satisfied.

patch_plan.description: Patch plan: files to touch and the smallest behavior-preserving change.

verification_plan.description: Verification plan: concrete verification commands, or NOT VERIFIED with a reason (never empty).

risks_not_verified.description: Risks / NOT VERIFIED: open risks and anything that will not be verified.
